title: THE SMEL TEST: A SIMPLE BENCHMARK FOR MEDIA LITERACY IN LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to factual questions and summarization tasks when presented with conflicting information from sources of varying trustworthiness (e.g., Encyclopedia Britannica vs. Reddit, 4chan, or Fanfiction) to measure if models inappropriately trust or incorporate information from dubious domains.

Comparing the difference in model accuracy on the 'resolving contradictions' subtask when the trustworthy source appears first in the prompt context versus when the untrustworthy source appears first.
